records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Blue Analytics!
records.body:
Hi Ahmed,

Your workspace for Blue Analytics is ready to go. The single highest-leverage thing in week one is creating a real project rather than a test one -- it's what makes the first week actually useful.

I'm here if anything's unclear.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: First project reached day 3 ([email:c0391d5e] follow-through) and kickoff held ([calendar:19b6f671]), so engagement exists; but no invites sent, no reply to the day-3 nudge ([email:47d62aa2]), no tickets, and only 8 days left — modest unaided odds.

draft.subject: One next step for Blue Analytics
draft.body:
Hi Ahmed,

Thanks again for the kickoff call — good to see your first project up in Wrenfield already. Projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so adding the real work from that project is usually what makes week one click.

The other piece that tends to help is getting your team in: a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm glad to walk through either step with you.

Best,
Chidi
